notes.title: Card Shark tips, tricks and a new game by our studio
notes.content:
[h2]Card Shark Tips and Tricks[/h2]

[previewyoutube=1wnhMMJgNAc;full][/previewyoutube]

We know that Card Shark can be difficult. The deck manipulation puzzles get particularly complex at the end of the game, sometimes requiring many steps of memorization and a robust understanding of certain card tricks. 

That's why we included a number of features in the [b]Pause Menu[/b] to help struggling players progress if they get stuck. We're aware that some of these options aren't very obvious so our Devolver friend, Jean-Michel, created this video! It showcases a number of tips that you can use if you are not able to move forward or want a more relaxed experience. 

[olist]
[*] You can practice as long as you want before tackling a trick at a real table
[*] The Pause Menu contains your current objective and a list of controls from previous tricks
[*] You can change the difficulty which primarily changes how fast suspicion builds 
[*] Turning [b]Hints [/b] ON will show cards that you need to memorize
[/olist]

[h2]A New Game by our Studio[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img]
Before Card Shark, our studio was founded out of the [url=reignsgame.com]Reigns series[/url] of narrative strategy games. After some bad luck on other projects, Francois (the original @Nerial himself and lead writer of Card Shark), developed the first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/474750/Reigns/]Reigns[/url] game in 2016. 

It was a simple but very clever concept, described as Tinder x Game of Thrones. As a kingdom's ruler, advisors come to you with their problems. Swipe right to accept or swipe left to reject. Each decision may impact the 4 stats which represent your areas of influence. If any of those 4 get too high or too low, you'll die a gruesome death. The peasants become too prosperous? They don't need your leadership anymore. Your military is too weak? Warring kingdoms will have your head. 

But death isn't the end. Your consciousness is transported into the next heir so that you can continue your reign. You'll need that time to uncover the mystery behind your newfound immortality. 

Multiple instalments and an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897820/Reigns_Game_of_Thrones/]official Game of Thrones game[/url] later, we have just released [url=https://www.reignsgame.com/three-kingdoms]Reigns: Three Kingdoms[/url], the most ambitious version yet. Based on the beloved epic, The Romance of the Three Kingdoms, it doesn't just have the most story, [b]it also has an entire deck-building card battle minigame with online multiplayer duels[/b]. 

It's currently available on Android and iOS for Netflix subscribers [url=https://www.netflix.com/game/81569952][b]HERE[/b][/url]. 

The original Reigns and two sequels are available on Steam for just a few dollars each!

notes.title: The Art of Card Shark Dev blog and a new lowest SALE price!
notes.content:
[h1]On sale at a new lowest price of 30% off! [/h1]

When making this game, we honestly weren't sure if anyone would want to play it. We knew that the gameplay would not be for everyone. It's a game about cards, but not a card game. Deck manipulation puzzles are bound by real-life and not traditional game mechanics. It encourages you to think and memorize but under significant time pressure.  

Despite that, we made a game full of artistry that we are very proud of. [b]If you want to support indie games that take ambitious risks like this, it would mean a lot to us if you bought or gifted Card Shark. [/b]

Thank you to everyone who has already taken that plunge and experienced what our team has worked so hard on. Whether it was a game for you or not, we really appreciate your support! 

And to celebrate this new lowest sale price, our lead artist, animator and cheat, Nicolai Troshinsky, has written this detailed developer blog. It shows how much work went into just one small aspect of the game.

[h1]Behind the Scenes - The Card in the Hat[/h1]

If you played Card Shark it might surprise you that out of all the different mini-games, the “Card In Hat” was by far the most difficult one to develop. We spent more time working on this interaction than on any other technique in the game. Minor spoilers ahead! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/0ef96d27e5876f05d6e6ecdd93174f7cbc0f6956.gif[/img]

Throughout the game, this technique appears just once and the interaction lasts only a few seconds. It seems absurd that such a short one-off moment took us so much work.

The idea came from this brilliant demonstration by legendary magician Ricky Jay. We immediately thought we had to have something like this in the game. So it was storyboarded and written from very early on in the project, becoming a necessary part of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/1467b84147f200d253d62a5857bc4f7701972983.gif[/img]

The basic idea was simple but making a card fly in 3D inside a hand-drawn 2D game was a big challenge. I naively thought we could have the card in actual 3D and simulate the physics but that was quickly discarded as too complicated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/014e97dc9b7b11858ed58776a1a178d25137a679.gif[/img]

I decided to solve the problem myself, in animation. Here's me trying it out to see how the card should behave. Not only the motion of the card would be a challenge but also it´s interaction with the chair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/6c0dd07b7c7c020d92fde2d854f5cd442e8947bb.gif[/img]

We originally tried to implement a more complex aiming system for which I built this trail that didn’t make it to the final version.  There are several animations accounting for hitting the chair, falling in the hat and rules to deal with draw order based on angle and strength of the shot. It got complicated fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/cb8037650c7e0c893144cc81c65dbbd1b6c63fd7.gif[/img]

It took me a lot of tests until I ended up figuring out a way to animate each axis on a separate bone and combine them in order to achieve the pseudo 3D motion. With a single animation I was able to scale and rotate the entire trajectory from a single bone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/fe3b72215c6eeadfe3484661ddc4480e748b26f3.gif[/img]

We originally tried to implement a more complex aiming system for which I built this trail that didn’t make it to the final version.  There are several animations accounting for hitting the chair, falling in the hat and rules to deal with draw order based on angle and strength of the shot. It got complicated fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/54f61e5c6b6a0ab974cb93965fda72ce5a48171b.gif[/img]

That was just the visual side! The interaction design was another big problem, it played terribly for the longest time. We tried so many things and they were all either incomprehensible, trivially easy or insanely difficult. A ton of work was discarded.

I think it was only finished around the very end of development. Looking back, was it worth it? What did you think of this part of the game? 

[b]Nicolai Troshinsky - Artist, Animator, Cheat[/b]

notes.title: We got a scam artist to critique Card Shark, here's what he thought
notes.content: Card Shark isn't like other card games you might have played. I've been hooked on deckbuilders time and time again over the years, but Card Shark is more like a deck decimator rather than anything else. See, Card Shark is about scamming French aristocrats and trying your best to avoid death along the way. There are plenty of tricks within the game to learn and trick your opponents with—but just how accurate are they?.. Read more.

notes.title: Жизнь карточного шулера: Обзор Card Shark
notes.content: Карточные игры всего за несколько лет успели превратиться из ниши для пенсионеров и скучающих клерков в динамично развивающийся жанр. И Devolver Digital, пожалуй, сделала для этого куда больше, чем остальные компании вместе взятые. Новый проект издательства подходит к азартной тематике под неожиданным углом. В Card Shark вы в роли помощника шулера должны подтасовывать карты и проворачивать другие трюки на просторах предреволюционной Франции. Иными словами, обманывать доверчивых и не очень богатых простофиль.

notes.title: Card Shark Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing Card Shark.
[/h3]
We tried to make a game that was unlike any other but to do that, tough design decisions had to be made. While it isn't a game for everyone, we are so glad that many of you have enjoyed the experience for what it is. The tension and stakes, the learning and progression, the themes and presentation. These are just a few of the elements we wanted to convey and our players understand that.

If you'd like to see how this game was made, you can watch the new mini-documentary that goes Behind the Schemes.

[previewyoutube=doeBqMtE7AU;full][/previewyoutube]
We are also very grateful that you've stayed patient despite the bugs!

Since launching last week, we've been hard at work to address the issues you reported here in the Steam forums, in our Discord server and on social media. We still have more improvements to make, but we wanted to get these ones to you ASAP.

Version 1.1 includes these fixes and changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Gambling House:[/b] Fixed softlock when not pouring enough wine.

[*] [b]Chateau:[/b] Fixed soft lock occurring mid deal if no card is stolen in Sticky Hand.
[*] [b]Cour des Miracles:[/b] Intro cut-scene now plays correctly when loading a save game.
[*] [b]Versaille:[/b] Fixed softlock in final round.
[*] [b]Theatre:[/b] Prevented Comte from sitting in first seat in strategy 16.
[*] [b]Second Deal:[/b] Fixed issues with input being remembered during dialogue.
[*] [b]Pincer Shuffle:[/b] Explanations can no longer get stuck when single-shuffling / injogging in final shuffle pass.
[*] [b]Full Harvest:[/b] Fixed mouse inputs being queued.

[*] [b]Endgame:[/b] Re-playing a completed game starts back at the tavern, with skip privileges and retained strategies.
[*] [b]Map:[/b] Fixed getting stuck with nowhere to go because returning to the Camp is unavailable.

[*] [b]Difficulty screen:[/b] Italian text no longer overflows.
[/list]

notes.title: Card Shark review: it's hard to deal yourself a good hand
notes.content:
Most video games about cards are deck-building strategy games. Digitised Magic The Gathering-likes. Card Shark is a card game about playing cards, and, more specifically, about cheating at playing cards. When I previewed it I said that it turned out I was quite good at cheating, but now I have played the full build I can report that I'm bad at that, too. The worst I can say about Card Shark is that it doesn't make failure fun.

Read more

notes.title: Card Shark review
notes.content: There are plenty of card games around at the moment. From Hearthstone to Inscryption, Slay the Spire to Monster Train, deck-building to set up lethal combinations is everywhere. But Card Shark is different. Card Shark is about cheating your opponents and being damn good at it... Read more.

notes.title: The Time for Cheating is Now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hQlknqTFcko;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Card Shark is now available for everyone to play! [/h3]

[i]We have brought together all sorts of ruffians, scoundrels and hooligans because a great opportunity has reached our midst. In Card Shark, you'll take the least ethical path to achieve wealth, fame and status by cheating your way up the aristocracy. 

But that path is also a dangerous one. The risks you take can leave you in worse shape than your humble beginnings or even take your life if you are not careful. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/a6e51aef9808c247e11662e5648f3dd7de4ddaa4.gif[/img]

From all of us at Nerial, we want to thank you sincerely for joining us on this journey to launch. Making a game is like manipulating a deck. Managing and fine-tuning each step to bring wonder out of what appears to be random chance. 

We believe we have created a unique and artful experience. To be completely honest, this isn't the type of game that typically performs very well on Steam. However, if you do enjoy our game, we hope that you'll leave a positive review! It really helps us continue to make games that reimagine real life in surprising ways. 

So as you start this new adventure of delectable deceit, we hope you will have fun, learn something new and cheat your opponents' pockets dry.

notes.title: Celebrate Card Shark Launch with us!
notes.content:
[h3]Card Shark will be in your hands soon! [/h3]
[previewyoutube=1967UU-2LVQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We've broken down the most important information about Card Shark before you play. Do you know which film inspired our game? Have you used Hint Mode? Learn the basics of cheating in What the Facts. 

[previewyoutube=ETfgV0_Axqk;full][/previewyoutube]
Our lead artist, Nicolai Troshinsky, performs card tricks in real life. In this series, he teaches some of the easiest techniques to perform so that you can always have the upper hand at the table. Every trick in Card Shark is derived from genuine cheaters and these videos modernize them! Did you ever think to use your phone as a secret mirror? It's the perfect place to start if you want to get your cheating career off the ground in real life. 

[previewyoutube=hXz2Bz3yWWY;full][/previewyoutube]
The Card Shark soundtrack is stunning thanks to the arrangements by Andrea Boccadoro and the live orchestra, recorded at Air Studios in London. Andrea composed original scores and rearranged period pieces to set the tones of the 18th century. My favourite example of reimagining source material appears later in the game, when you'll meet [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevalier_de_Saint-Georges]Chevalier de St Georges[/url]. He was both a master (fencing) duelist and musical composer. His theme in the game is rearranged from music he actually wrote in the 1700s! 

You can also see Andrea in the video wearing the dark t-shirt at 1:35!

notes.title: Card Shark has stacked the deck for June 2nd
notes.content:
[h3]Who says that cheaters never prosper? Card Shark launches on June 2nd. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=6ARLZYZvKm0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The time is finally upon us, my dear colleague. You have stacked the deck, rigged the hand, but are you ready to uncover the truth?

You gather we're not travelling together by chance? You've seen but a glimpse of the tricks I have in store. You've seen an elementary introduction to the dastardly world where I honed my arts. Despite your better judgement, you have tasted secrets that were never meant for human lips. 

At this juncture, only one option remains. You and I must persevere with this investigation we have started. I suspect this conspiracy may take us to the very top of the monarchy or to the bottom of the criminal underbelly. We may even see both of them at the same table. 

If you choose to accept this invitation, you will be risking your fame, status, and what little possessions you may have. The stakes are rising every round so we can add your life to that wager. 

On the [b]2nd day of June[/b], I will meet you here again. It will be a new beginning as you search for the truth, but the end of your time as a truthful person. 
[/i]

notes.title: LudoNarraCon - We're hosting a panel about historical games!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/33025617/view/3210513624465774753][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/32644c3c381a3e9c78cb480d48330b35bfeea737.png[/img][/url]

Games let us experience people and places beyond what we can see in real life. We're speaking to developers who use that power to take us back in time! Making a game in a historical setting has unique challenges to balance accuracy with gameplay for a modern audience. [b]Our panel will discuss various questions about narrative games that take inspiration from the past.[/b]

You can watch our panel at this event page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/33025617/view/3210513624465774753
[b]LudoNarraCon[/b] is full of amazing games that push the boundaries of how we can use our interactive medium to tell stories. This year's schedule is outstanding, featuring developers behind some of our favourite games. You can watch all the panels and check out the awesome stories at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon]event page[/url]! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/61975d1bdbada5fea3a000876e105b436b17e5c9.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Please check out the games by our lovely panelists as well! [/h3]

In [b]Inua - A Story In Ice and Time[/b], you'll investigate the mystery of the Franklin Expedition through three different time periods. While Western academics and explorers took over 150 yeras to find these lost shipwrecks in the Northern Passage, the Inuit have passed down stories about their whereabouts this entire time. Florent Maurin and his team spoke with Inuit elders to ensure they were telling a story that goes beyond what the European history books missed for all these years. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479890/Inua__A_Story_in_Ice_and_Time/

[b]Windrush Tales[/b] will take you to the lives and struggles of the Windrush Generation. Rebuilding after WWII, the UK invited people from British Colonies in the Caribbean to fill a labour shortage, only to treat them with harsh discrimination. This is a personal story for Chella Ramaman, whose father came to England during this era. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1758770/Windrush_Tales/

notes.title: New Card Shark Gameplay Walkthrough
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RImi-QD1JRU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Tricksters! Let me teach you a classic cheating technique. [/h3]

Our lead artist, Nicolai Troshinsky, studied card cheating to accurately depict techniques used by real life scammers. Every trick in Card Shark is grounded in reality. You can try them for yourself although we are not responsible for the consequences!

This gameplay walkthrough shows a scene after the end of the demo. In it, Nicolai explains each step of a new set of tricks. As you progress in the game, you'll need to perform a wider variety of techniques which will test your memory, execution, and ability to handle pressure. 

Cheating often involves gaining more information than your opponent. There are many ways to mark cards but to be effective, it should be readable yet subtle. I can't wait to see the creative patterns you'll paint on your marked decks. 

[h3]Card Shark News[/h3]
More Card Shark news is coming [b]very soon[/b]! Join our other communities where we share real cheating techniques, magic tricks, and game info.

notes.title: International Women's Day Stream!
notes.content:
[h3]We are lucky that amazing women lead, make, and play our games! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/4b851565ce3be9aabe4fcf4d58cbf9ffbb738084.png[/img]

To celebrate International Women's Day, [url=https://twitter.com/daisy_fernandez]Daisy Fernandez[/url], designer and writer on Card Shark, and [url=https://twitter.com/nicolehe]Nicole He[/url], game designer and Nerial collaborator, will be [b]streaming the Card Shark Demo from 4-6pm ET on Tuesday, March 8th! [/b]

At Nerial, we strive to make games that bring surprising ideas to the table. Those ideas often come from people with diverse backgrounds; people who had to fight against biases, stigma and stereotypes to carve their paths in this industry. [b]Diversity makes us better. [/b]

To showcase this, the [url=bit.ly/WomenDayEvent]WINGS Women’s Day Steam Event[/url] is highlighting many awesome indie games made by studios with women and people of marginalized genders in key positions. 

Here are a few of my favourites!
[list][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/983970/Haven/]Haven[/url] is a narrative-driven, 3D action-adventure game with stylish combat and striking visuals. They’ve just released a free update that lets you play as same-gender couples! [/list] [list][*]Hitchhike through a modern adventure in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96/]Road 96[/url]. It blends emotive storytelling with procedural generation to give every player a story that is entirely their own. [/list] [list][*]TAKE PICTURES OF DOGS IN [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1028350/Pupperazzi/]PUPPERAZZI[/url]! [/list] [list][*]If you followed Steam Next Fest you may have played the Demo of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121640/The_Wandering_Village/]The Wandering Village[/url]. Grow your farming community on the back of a giant animal as you co-exist in a hostile, yet beautiful world.  [/list] [list][*]Climb to the top of a haunted hotel with deck-building combat in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727590/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT/]The Spirit Lift[/url]! While the game is early in development, you can follow their veteran team’s progress on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drmikachu]Twitch[/url].  [/list]
[b]Happy International Women’s Day from all of us at Nerial! [/b]

notes.title: I became a highly skilled cheater in Card Shark, and only got stabbed to death once
notes.content: I'm traveling by stagecoach across the French countryside from card game to card game as my mentor teaches me how to cheat. Posing as his valet, I peek at his opponent's cards while refilling their wine glasses, then signal the suit of their best card to him by wiping the table with a cloth using a certain motion. It's a crude, basic cheat, but it's just the tip of the iceberg in con-artist adventure game Card Shark... Read more.

notes.content:
Look. If you just wanna shuffle decks, there’s no shortage of good card games on PC, But if you wanna cheat at cards? Well, there really ain’t much stock for your kind. Enter Card Shark, a con-artist’s dream of cheating your way through 18th-century France in search of fame, fortune, and a seat at the king’s table from the creators of Reigns. Just don’t get shot on the way, yeah?
